function: Multi-user channel extrapolation (prediction) across time, frequency and space, reconstructing full spatial CSI from partial antenna CSI, plus future subcarrier-allocation extrapolation (pp. 1-3).
system: TDD massive MIMO, BS with 16x16 single-polarized UPA, single-antenna users, near-field non-stationary, 28 GHz, 51 subcarriers; no RIS (pp. 2, 4).
method: TGCN (graph convolution plus GRU) and dual-discriminator GAN (2DGAN); supervised NMSE plus adversarial loss, stepwise training: 2DGAN first, then whole network with frozen generator (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Channel data generated with the 6G channel simulator BUPTCMCCCMG-IMT2030 (GBSM with Rician factor); greedy algorithm allocates subcarriers to build the dataset; no split stated (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Users move randomly within 12 m of BS at 2-25 m/s; tests sweep extrapolation step, ratio r, SNR, 1-21 users; training conditions not stated (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Learned only: LSTM [2], GAN-GRU [5], CNN [6]; Perfect-CSI oracle as upper bound; no classical non-learned extrapolation baseline (pp. 4-5).
metrics: Multi-user average NMSE, multi-user average spectral efficiency (SE) versus SNR, and extrapolation delay versus number of users (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Order of complexity O_total = O_TGCN(N^2 F + T V^2) + O_2DGAN(L C^2 P), Eq. (16); extrapolation delay plotted in Fig. 5 (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "Channel data is generated using the 6G channel simulator BUPTCMCCCMG-IMT2030 [14]"; p. 2: "We use a geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) [10] for channel modeling". Not met: a custom GBSM simulator; the paper names no 3GPP TR 38.901, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or QuaDRiGa model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "the users move randomly within a 12-meter radius near the BS, with speeds ranging from 2 m/s to 25 m/s"; p. 5: "when the number of users increases from 1 to 21". Not met: the paper never states the training configuration or a train/test mismatch, only sweeps of the extrapolation step, ratio r, SNR and users.
q3_support: p. 4: "existing channel extrapolation methods: (1) Time-domain extrapolation using a LSTM [2]", then GAN-GRU [5] and CNN [6]. Not met: all three baselines are learned; Fig. 6 on p. 5 adds only Perfect CSI, an oracle bound, and no non-learned extrapolation method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "The overall complexity is" O_total = O_TGCN(N^2 F + T V^2) + O_2DGAN(L C^2 P), Eq. (16) in Section III-D Complexity Analysis, the order of the proposed network.
q5_support: p. 4: "Channel data is generated using the 6G channel simulator BUPTCMCCCMG-IMT2030 [14]". Not met: no code or data link or DOI, no public channel dataset, no measured data; the simulated data are not released.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 2: channel extrapolation (prediction) and spatial CSI completion, main metric NMSE; the subcarrier-allocation extrapolation (p. 3) is a secondary output. q1: the simulator BUPTCMCCCMG-IMT2030 is not described as 3GPP-based or standardized, so the reviewer may confirm. q3: the Perfect CSI curve of Fig. 6 is an oracle bound, not a non-learned method.
